Explore Our Work Theory of Change

Our Three Priority Areas

💻

Digital Learning, AI & Innovation

We equip young people with skills that go beyond screens — from digital literacy and coding to understanding AI. Through hands-on workshops and innovation challenges, we help youth become critical thinkers and makers in an AI-shaped world, not passive consumers of it.

🌱

Climate Action and Resilience

Young people are the most affected by the climate crisis — and the most determined to confront it. We support youth to understand their local environment, connect it to global systems, and build community-led responses that are practical and sustained.

⚖️

Mental Health and Gender Equality

We challenge gender norms, build mental wellbeing literacy, and create safe spaces where every young person — especially girls and those most marginalised — can grow, lead, and belong.

Who We Are

A youth-centered organization built on the belief that change starts within communities.

Lead Now Foundation is a registered Section 8 company based in Delhi, India. We exist to build the leadership, skills, and collective power of young people, positioning them not as recipients of development, but as its architects.

We work at the intersection of youth leadership, community transformation, and systems change. Our approach is grounded in co-creation: every programme, every strategy, every solution is built with the communities we serve, never for them.

Vision

Thriving, inclusive, and resilient communities shaped by young people who lead collective action and influence systems for lasting social change.

Mission

Lead Now Foundation builds the leadership, skills, and power of young people to drive community transformation and systems change, with young people not as beneficiaries, but as co-creators of their own futures.

Legal Status

Incorporated under Section 8 of the Companies Act, 2013, Delhi, India.
CIN: U85100DL2018NPL339705
Date of Incorporation: 13 September 2018

Our Approach

Why we exist and how we understand change.

A deep belief that young people are the world's most underutilised force for transformation.

We believe the world's greatest untapped resource is the leadership potential of young people, particularly those who have been overlooked, excluded, and underestimated.

Lead Now Foundation exists not to do things for young people, but to create the conditions in which they can do extraordinary things themselves. We reject the idea that young people are problems to be solved, or populations to be managed. We see them as the most credible architects of their own communities' futures.

We understand that individual transformation and systemic change are not separate, they are deeply linked. When one young person leads, others follow. When communities organise, systems shift. And when young people are genuinely resourced and trusted, nothing is out of reach.

Our work begins at the intersection of leadership and belonging, where a young person first discovers that their voice matters, their ideas have power, and their community needs them. From that moment, we walk alongside them.

NURTURE

Invest in untapped potential

We invest in the leadership potential of young people, especially those historically marginalised. Tailored training, workshops, and mentorship that meets each person where they are.

CONNECT

Build collective power

The collective power of young people is a formidable force. We build connections across communities, civil society, and networks, breaking barriers and amplifying voices.

RESOURCE

Fund what matters

We raise and channel resources to young leaders and youth-led organisations, so that their priorities, not ours, drive the agenda. Flexible funding for flexible change.

INFLUENCE

Shift systems and power

We work to change the structures and systems that determine who leads and who is listened to. Advocacy, policy engagement, and institutional accountability at every level.

What We Stand For

Five principles. One direction.

These values are not aspirational statements pinned to a wall. They are the decisions we make every day: how we run programmes, how we treat partners, how we spend money, and how we talk about the communities we work with.

They exist to be challenged, not just celebrated.

01

Youth Agency

Young people lead, decide and create, not just participate. Their voice is not a consultation mechanism. It is the decision-making authority.

02

Equity

We name and address power, especially for those most excluded. Equity is not about treating everyone the same. It is about giving everyone what they need.

03

Collaboration

We build movements, not empires, with partners and peers. No single organisation has the full answer. Working together is not a compromise; it is the strategy.

04

Dignity

Every person and every community deserves respect and care. This is not performative. It shapes every word we write, every decision we make, every relationship we hold.

05

Systems Thinking

We look beyond quick fixes toward lasting, structural change. The root causes of injustice are systemic. The solutions must be too.

How Change Happens

From the inside out. From the ground up.

Our Theory of Change reflects a deep conviction: that when young people — especially those historically excluded — are genuinely supported, trusted, and resourced, they become the most powerful and sustainable force for social transformation.

Change does not begin in policy documents or donor strategies. It begins the moment a young person discovers their own voice matters. From that spark, it moves outward — into communities, into institutions, into systems. Our work is to ignite that spark, and then walk alongside young people as it grows into a flame.

The Change Pathway
✦
The Spark
A young person discovers their voice matters
Stage 01
Individual Leadership
Young people develop confidence, skills, and agency — not through instruction, but through experience and genuine belief that their leadership is needed.
How we do it
  • Leadership training & experiential learning
  • Mentorship and coaching
  • Life skills, civic engagement, systems thinking
  • Exposure visits and peer learning spaces
Stage 02
Community Impact
Young leaders unite around shared challenges, mobilise peers, and co-create solutions with real consequences for their streets, schools, and neighbourhoods.
How we do it
  • Youth-led community action projects
  • Youth Hacks — solve local challenges
  • Community campaigns & collective action
  • Building youth collectives & platforms
Stage 03
Sustained Systems Change
Youth leadership becomes embedded within institutions and governance — shifting who leads, who decides, and who benefits. The structures themselves change.
How we do it
  • Strengthening youth-led organisations
  • Cross-sector partnerships & coalitions
  • Advocacy and policy engagement
  • Flexible funding for youth priorities
🌍
Vision
Thriving communities led by young people
Levels of Change

Individual Change

Confidence grows. Agency deepens. A young person stops seeing themselves as a product of their circumstances and starts reshaping them.

Community Change

Young leaders organise real people, solve real problems. Communities become more cohesive and capable — led from within, not managed from outside.

Institutional Change

Youth-led organisations grow stronger. Funders shift priorities. What was once considered fringe becomes a field standard — youth leadership as conviction, not strategy.

Systemic Change

Policies reflect community realities. Governance becomes accountable. The systems that once excluded young people begin to carry their fingerprints — because they built them.

Long-Term Vision

Thriving, inclusive, and resilient communities shaped by young people who lead collective action and influence systems for lasting social change.
